limits: nested KVM and emulated shared CXL on one physical host, not physical multi-host hardware
one vCPU, 128MiB guest, identical kernel/module KVA and CXL GPA/PFNs; contiguous device-DAX RAM
A retains Firecracker control/device runtime; B executes the shared vCPU using the existing native probe; no block/network/vsock handoff
VM logical clock rebased/frozen at handoff; per-epoch monotonic checks do not establish UTC accuracy
shared bump allocator retains retired DAX allocations until lab shutdown; no production graph destruction/reclamation
cooperative no-concurrent-VM-ioctl/VMA-mutation contract; arbitrary foreign-kernel mutex waiters are unsupported
One VM per shared arena; fixed contiguous DAX RAM and identical PFNs; no concurrent VM ioctl or VMA mutation during handoff
Final clock policy freezes logical guest time and rebases guest TSC against a fresh destination clock generation; equal host TSC frequency required; not a UTC accuracy guarantee
Earlier soak images are separately archived and must not be counted as final TSC-corrected image validation
